300:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
301:     if (words.empty()) {
302:         return std::nullopt;
303:     }
304: 
305:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
306:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
307:         return std::nullopt;
308:     }
309: 
310:     std::vector<Index> matches;
311:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
312:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
313:         bool is_phrase = true;
314: 
315:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
316:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);

323:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
324:             });
